# AEO Command

> Multi-tenant Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) platform for marketing agencies.

AEO Command helps agencies scan client websites, produce a prioritized Action Center of fixes, track AI visibility prompts over time, and deliver white-label reports.

## Product

- Website AEO scan (crawl + analysis)
- Action Center with assignable tasks and suggested fixes
- Visibility prompt tracking
- White-label live report links
- Team invites and multi-client isolation
- Pakistan and International pricing
